audience: sales teams who manage leads and deals in Teamgate CRM

useCases.title: Review open deals by stage with their values
useCases.text: The AI lists deals by status, stage or owner with value and expected closing date, and reads the pipeline stages.

useCases.title: See new leads and who owns them
useCases.text: The AI lists leads by creation date, status, source or owner, and shows contact details.

useCases.title: Find a company, its people and its deals
useCases.text: The AI searches for a company by name, lists the people who work there and its deals, and sums it up.

useCases.title: Read the activities linked to a record
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks, calls, appointments and notes linked to one lead, person, company or deal.

useCases.title: Add a lead, person, company or deal
useCases.text: The AI creates a lead, a person linked to a company with a job title, a company, or a deal for a buyer.

useCases.title: Update deals, add notes or schedule activities
useCases.text: The AI changes a deal, for example moves it to another stage or marks it won or lost. It can add a note or create a task, call or appointment.
